new_candidates.requirement: After copying a successfully parsed event, the target must continue parsing so a flow-sequence mapping key can reach the added end-token branch.
new_candidates.target_route: The entry passes YAML bytes after two control bytes to yaml_parser_parse. A flow sequence with an empty explicit key would pass through the mapping-key state to the added branch.
new_candidates.failure_condition: The first successful parse produces a stream-start event. Its copy initializer returns 1, and the harness treats that success as a reason to jump to cleanup before another parse call.
new_candidates.alternative_paths: The complete entry has no other parse call before that exit and no other route to the changed branch.
